subject.why: The open cherry-red notebook, yellow pencil, footprint sketch, and ribbon bookmark are all clearly depicted and instantly readable.

category.why: It follows category 3 with a stylized wooden tabletop and a clean, prop-free violet-purple gradient wall behind it.

clean.why: There is no text, numbers, UI, card frames, or characters; the simple footprint sketch adheres to the brief.

framing.why: The notebook is centrally framed with ample margins on all four sides and a chunky, readable silhouette.

colour.why: The palette is bright and saturated with excellent contrast between the warm desk, violet wall, and vibrant red/yellow notebook elements.

detail.why: Detail levels are well controlled with smooth surfaces, stylized wood grain, and no micro-clutter.

style.why: The 3D render perfectly matches the reference cards with smooth, chunky shapes, soft highlights, and a clean satin finish.

bg_colour.why: background is purple (90% of the background); planned purple
